title: Kling 4.0 Flash
description: Kuaishou Kling 4.0 Flash, the faster, lower-cost Kling 4.0, with generated sound (dialogue, music and sound effects described in the prompt). One model for text-to-video; image-to-video from a first frame; reference images of characters, products, places or styles; reference videos to take motion, camera work or style from; and editing a video (supply a `video` and describe the change: the output keeps its length and shape). A first frame and reference images combine; there is no last frame (use kling-4.0 for one). Name inputs in the prompt by position: @image_1, @image_2, ... (first frame, then reference images) and @video_1, ... (the video to edit, then reference videos). 720p at 24 fps, 3-20 seconds. Billed per second of output: 123 credits. With any input video the rate is 82 credits per second, for the output plus the longer of the input videos and the output: editing a 5-second clip bills 10 seconds. POST /v1/cost quotes any request exactly.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for text-to-video and reference-only jobs. A first frame or a video to edit sets the shape and this is ignored.

image.description: Optional first frame (@image_1): the video starts from it and takes its shape. Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. JPG or PNG, at least 300px on each side, aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2. Can't be combined with `video`. (No last frame: use kling-4.0 for a first and a last frame.)

length_seconds.description: Video length in seconds, any whole number from 3 to 20. Ignored when editing a `video` (the output keeps its length).

prompt.description: Text description of the video, including the sound you want, or the change to make when editing a `video`. Name inputs by position: @image_1, @image_2, ... (first frame, then reference images) and @video_1, @video_2, ... (the video to edit, then reference videos). Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images of characters, products, places or styles, named in the prompt as @image_N (numbered after `image`). Up to 10 images in all, counting `image`. Same input forms and limits as `image`. No extra charge.

reference_videos.description: Optional reference videos to take motion, camera work or style from, named in the prompt as @video_N (numbered after `video`). MP4 or MOV, 3-20 seconds each, 700-4553 pixels on each side, aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2, up to 100MB each; up to 5 videos and 20 seconds in all, counting `video`. Each item is a public video URL or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Any input video moves the job to the video-input rate, billed for the output plus the longer of the input videos and the output: see POST /v1/cost.

video.description: Optional video to EDIT (@video_1): describe the change in `prompt`. The output keeps the clip's length and aspect ratio, so `length_seconds` and `aspect_ratio` are ignored. Same limits as `reference_videos`; can't be combined with `image`. Billed at the video-input rate for twice the clip's length in whole seconds (plus any reference videos).
